title: land waits for or steps past a worker sub-session's session-end distill instead of stopping at step branch
goal: Retrospective of SP-etslk6yu: land of ST-bl3hdung stopped at step branch because a session-end hook (querylog.py distill --settle 2 of a Haiku sub-session of the worker) still ran in the worker's worktree after 61 s; it ran over 8 minutes and the orchestrator had to wait and land again. land waits up to a bound for a session-end distill it can name, or distill of a worker's sessions runs from the clone's own query log directory and not from the worktree, so the worktree can be removed; a test plants a worktree with a running distill process and finds land waiting, then proceeding.
